'''Delcan Finyaft''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] ship mechanic credited with creating the "floating cantina" known as [[Port Nowhere]]. He purchased an [[Azalus-class Hutt dreadnaught|''Azalus''-class Hutt dreadnaught]], the ''Potentate's Pride,'' from the one-time [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Supreme Mogul]], [[Barabbula]] the Hutt. Finyaft spent six years with a full crew retrofitting the vessel and re-opened it as a mobile cantina under the name Port Nowhere.
